method: Same browser and viewport; unsaved utilities preview with interactions, noon lighting and land seed 42. Each 4x comparison started from a reload. Queued cases placed a Gathering place through the catalog at screen coordinate (572,925). requestAnimationFrame intervals include slow frames; the built-in HUD excludes intervals >=250ms. First interval excluded from summaries. The 1x-off sample was warm; queued samples include work startup. Single-run diagnostic measurements, not controlled statistical benchmarks.
findings: Severe construction-related stalls reproduce with every lens off.
Queued work at 4x reached 2.7 fps and 1.33-second maximum frame intervals; at 1x it reached 13 fps and 1.11-second maximum intervals.
The HUD reported 92 fps during the 2.7 fps capture because it excludes slow intervals.
The fresh 4x preview averaged 80.6 fps without a lens and 75.2 fps with the construction lens; that comparison did not include a queued construction project.
scope: Diagnosis only. No simulation or FPS-counter code changed. Temporary frame probes and profiling were removed by restoring the original paused preview. Raw profiles are local artifacts.
